# `core/memory/VertexPool.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/memory/VertexPool.js`

VertexPool.js - Persistent Vertex Buffer Pool High-performance vertex memory management system that: 1. Allocates a single large persistent buffer 2. Divides it into fixed-size buckets for chunks 3. Supports instant allocation/deallocation without GPU buffer creation 4. Enables single-draw-call rendering of all chunks Based on Nick McDonald's vertex pooling technique: https://nickmcd.me/2021/04/04/high-performance-voxel-engine/

## Classes

### `class VertexPool`

VertexPool - Manages a large persistent vertex buffer with bucket allocation

| `updateBucket` | `updateBucket(chunkKey, vertexData, faceCount, center = [0, 0, 0])` | Update vertex data for a bucket |
| `sortFrontToBack` | `sortFrontToBack(cameraPos)` | Sort chunks front-to-back for early-Z optimization |
| `applyBackFaceCulling` | `applyBackFaceCulling(cameraForward)` | Apply back-face culling based on camera direction Masks out faces that point away from camera |
| `uploadDrawCommands` | `uploadDrawCommands()` | Upload draw commands to GPU |

| `getBucket` | `getBucket(chunkKey)` | Get bucket info for a chunk |

### `class FaceOrientedVertexPool`

FaceOrientedVertexPool - Vertex pool with 6 sub-buckets per chunk for true back-face culling Each chunk gets 6 smaller buckets, one per face direction

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(config = {})` |  |
| `init` | `async init(device)` |  |
| `allocate` | `allocate(chunkKey)` | Allocate buckets for a chunk (one per face direction) |
| `free` | `free(chunkKey)` | Free all buckets for a chunk |
| `updateFace` | `updateFace(chunkKey, faceDir, vertexData, faceCount, center)` | Update face data for a chunk |
| `updateVisibleFaces` | `updateVisibleFaces(cameraForward)` | Update visible faces based on camera direction (true back-face culling) |
| `render` | `render(pass, pipeline, bindGroup)` | Render all visible chunks with true back-face culling Only renders face pools that are visible from camera direction |
| `loadConfig` | `loadConfig(cfg)` | Load configuration from engine.cfg section |
| `destroy` | `destroy()` |  |
